## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `da22e1db2a63451221fbab6ad0635ee859ea2396`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0079-record-display-name.md + packages/objectql/src/engine.ts, packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts, packages/objectql/src/record-title.ts, packages/objectql/src/hook-run-as.ts, packages/objectql/src/hook-wrappers.ts, packages/spec/src/data/field-value.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/data/search-fields.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts, packages/formula/src/validate.ts, packages/formula/src/relationship-traversal.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/field-masker.ts, packages/runtime/src/sandbox/body-runner.ts, packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts, packages/runtime/src/sandbox/script-runner.ts, packages/runtime/src/stored-metadata-reader-seam.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts, docs/adr/0048-cross-package-metadata-collision.md, scripts/check-partof-closing-keyword.mjs, scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs, scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs

Inputs: card #24197 (the body with its `Ruled:` line, and all 19 comments: the two seat notes, the three claims per part, the three dispatches, the four `os-dev-report` comments read as claims, the ACCEPTs and the two landing comments), the earlier records 6247399985 (PR #24274) and 6249342777 (PR #24307), PR #24323 (body, the one-file list, zero review comments), the net diff `2b7fc52c36..da22e1db2a` (merge base `2b7fc52c36`, +77/−0, read with `git diff` and `git show pr/24323:PATH`), and the head's check-runs. Every cited file is byte-identical between `pr/24323` and `origin/main` `1ef0ee89d4` (blob ids compared), so what is read below is `main`. `d537a318b` (#24274) and `1bf5f6e17c` (#24307) are ancestors of the head. Nothing was built, run or re-run; the dev's gate claims were not reproduced.

Check-runs on `da22e1db2a`, read at 2026-10-18T12:44Z: 43, all completed, none in progress. 31 success — among them `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core` (and its six shards), `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, every Lint and Type Check lane, `Check Changeset`, `Check Documentation Links`, `Check PR Size`, the three claim and card guards and `Dogfood Regression Gate`. 11 skipped by path or opt-in (`Build Core`, `Build Docs`, `Console Pin Gate`, `Dogfood Verify CLI`, the Dogfood matrix placeholder, `Temporal Conformance`, both `Packed-tarball smoke`, and the first runs of `Auto Label`, `Check PR Size` and `Check Changeset`, each re-run green). **1 failure: `Part-of PR must not also close its card`** — see ③.6. That red is a PR-body verdict, not a diff verdict, and it is not the ground of the FAIL below.

### ① Derived judgments

The diff is two hunks in one governed file: one `- **Addenda**:` pointer line in the header block (the spelling ADR-0048 line 11 uses) and one appended section after the last bullet of `## Alternatives considered`. Provenance, Context, D1–D10, the status table, the open questions and the alternatives are untouched (the diff adds 77 lines and deletes none, and every added line is in those two hunks). The pointer's fragment is github-slugger's slug of the new heading (derived by hand, and `Check Documentation Links` is green). The ruling is quoted verbatim: the blockquote, unwrapped, equals the `Ruled:` line's sentence byte for byte (the line's trailing board-state words, "p1 `target:v18` stands …", are not part of the ruling and are rightly left out). Neither `24284` nor `24316` appears in the addendum, and neither card's path is described: item 9 states today's refusals and the auto-default set, not the silent-widening defect of #24284; item 4 says nothing about stored-metadata family tables. It changes no recorded decision: the two qualifications (the Alternatives bullet's "*can* return and query"; D1's "real STORED") are made in the addendum's own text, as the claim fence allows, and neither reverses D1's structural invariant — a formula title is still the one declared title field; what is corrected is the word "stored".

Each behavioural statement, judged against the code at this head:

1. One hop through `lookup` / `master_detail` / `user` / `tree`; preloaded once per page, one batched read per reference field, never per row; the reader's own permissions; on `find`, `findOne` and the insert and update responses — **RIGHT.** `planFormulaProjection` (`engine.ts` 1674) plans `hops` off `collectReferenceTraversals`, whose arbiter is `referenceTargetOf` (`field-value.zod.ts` 207) over `REFERENCE_VALUE_TYPES` = lookup, master_detail, user, tree (154). `resolveFormulaRelated` (6194) folds a plan's hops into one `wanted` map and calls `resolveOneHopRelated(…, 'caller')` (10054) once over the rows it is handed; that loader collects the page's distinct FK ids and issues one `find` per reference field with `where id $in` and `fields [id, ...named]`; for `authority === 'caller'` `bound` is false, so no second own-read and no SYSTEM spread — the hop query carries `context` unchanged (10180–10185). Call sites: `find` passes the driver page `result` after limit/offset (14017–14022), `findOne` (14306–14310), and `hydrateWriteFormulas` (2794) with a `relatedFor` from both of its callers, inside `insert` (16047, method at 15059) and `update` (17845, method at 16239).

2. Missing or unreadable related record leaves the formula `null` with a reported reason, never a computed fallback; the reason does not say which of the two held; an empty reference is evaluated — **RIGHT.** `formulaHopScope` (2646) answers `ok: false` before any evaluation for a binding with no row, and `applyFormulaPlan` (2695) then writes `null` and hands the reason to the fault sink (`formulaFaultSink` 6281 → `reportFormulaFault`, `warn`, once per object-field pair). `formulaHopRefusal` (2676) words `unresolved` as "it does not exist, or this reader may not read it". A `no-reference` binding (the per-row closure at 10210–10233 answers it for a null, array or object FK value) is pushed to `empty` and the formula IS evaluated over the stored empty value, the fault on a plain read naming the optional-read repair (2744–2750). One precision note in ③.8.

3. Lint refuses a second hop and a bare-and-traversed reference; run time reads `null` with the same reason; a related object's own hop is not served when it is itself read as a hop — **RIGHT.** `judgeFieldFormula` (`validate-expressions.ts` 2707) passes `traversalHydration: true` (2750); `validate.ts` 1131 judges the `value` role with `subject: 'formula'` and refuses with `TRAVERSAL_CONFLICT_CODE` (235: `traversal-bare-and-traversed`, `traversal-multi-hop`). The engine judges the same expression with the same function — `referenceTraversalConflicts(expr, schema.fields, 'formula')` (`rule-validator.ts` 645 → `findTraversalConflicts` → `findFormulaTraversalConflicts`, `relationship-traversal.ts` 334/402) — and stores its sentences as `hopConflict` (1701), which `applyFormulaPlan` reports with `null` (2713–2716). `formulaHopReads` (6169) marks every caller-authority hop query (10187); a `find` handed one gets the second-hop sentence from `resolveFormulaRelated` (6211–6215), so the related object's own traversing formula reads `null`.

4. FLS on the carrying object's own reference column does not stop the hop; formulas compute before the field mask; the control is FLS on the formula field — **RIGHT.** `applyFormulaPlan` runs inside the operation on the driver rows (14017), while plugin-security's middleware masks `opCtx.result` in step 4 after `await next()` (`security-plugin.ts` 4267 → 4313 → `maskOperationResult` 9467), whose `fieldMasker.maskResults` deletes a non-readable key by name (`field-masker.ts` 108/184), a formula key included. The related object's own FLS does apply to the hop, because the hop is the caller's `find`.

5. `ctx.title()` over the in-flight state; one batched read per reference field on the body's `ctx.api` channel, its identity (SYSTEM under `runAs: 'system'`) and its open transaction's connection; null for a hidden or missing related record or a second hop — **RIGHT, for hook bodies.** `buildTitleSurface` (`body-runner.ts` 243) reads `hookRecordState(engineCtx)` (`hook-wrappers.ts` 1134: stored ⊕ payload, materialised) and, when the handed-in channel has `serveFormulaField`, calls `resolveServedRecordTitle` (`record-title.ts` 173) → `ScopedContext.serveFormulaField` (`engine.ts` 21780, passing `this.executionContext`) → `ObjectQL.serveFormulaField` (6255), the read path's own four calls. The channel is `txState.api ?? ctx.api`, resolved at call time (`quickjs-runner.ts` 900); the seam Proxy's default branch forwards the method bound to the ScopedContext (`stored-metadata-reader-seam.ts` 439–440). `withRunAs('system')` is `sudo()` (21439). The host answers `undefined` and the VM wire hands the body `value ?? null` (903), so a body sees `null`.

6. A channel that cannot read serves no hop: own-column title resolves, title over a reference is `null` — **RIGHT.** `withRunAs('user')` with no `userId` returns `UnscopedHookApi` (21440; `hook-run-as.ts` 141), which has no `serveFormulaField`; `buildTitleSurface` falls to the synchronous `resolveRecordTitle` (273) → `evaluateFormulaField` (2863), which passes no `related`, so `formulaHopScope` answers `FORMULA_HOP_NOT_SERVED` and the formula is `null`; an own-column formula evaluates.

7. FLS on the title field itself is not applied to `ctx.title()` — **RIGHT.** `ObjectQL.serveFormulaField` returns `scratch[field]` with no middleware pass over the own record, and `resolveServedRecordTitle` / `resolveRecordTitle` fall back to `record[field]` off the hook state unmasked.

8. `ctx.title('FIELD')` answers the related title as its `findOne` served it, one-hop title included — **RIGHT.** `buildTitleSurface` 283–288: `source.object(target.object).findOne({ where: { id } })` on the same channel, then `servedRecordTitle` (`record-title.ts` 200) reads the row's title key, never re-derives. The related `findOne` is not a marked hop query, so its own one hop is served.

9. Stored nowhere; sort refused `400 INVALID_SORT`; request `searchFields` refused `400 INVALID_FIELD`; a `searchableFields` entry dropped; never in the auto-default set — **RIGHT, and pre-existing.** `planFormulaProjection` keeps formula names out of the driver projection (1716–1724); `assertOrderByIsMaterializable` (1848; code `INVALID_SORT`, `status` 400 at 1901–1909) runs on `find` (13924) and `findOne` (14242); `assertSearchFieldsAreSearchable` (`protocol.ts` 13539) refuses a virtual entry at 13642–13658 with `INVALID_FIELD` 400 (13702–13703); `resolveSearchFieldResolution` (`search-fields.ts` 242) filters declared entries by `isVirtualSearchField` (110, over `SEARCH_VIRTUAL_TYPES` = formula, 96); `autoDefaultFields` (127) admits `SEARCHABLE_TEXTUAL_TYPES` and `SEARCHABLE_ENUM_TYPES` only (167), neither naming formula.

10. The group heading **"Hook and action bodies"** over items 5–8 — **WRONG.** `ctx.title()` is a hook-face accessor only. `buildTitleSurface` is called once, on the hook face (`body-runner.ts` 371); the hook context object carries `title` with the comment "Hook face only. The action face has its own record shape … deliberately not taken here — the ruling names hook bodies" (1168); the action context object (about 1230–1247) carries no `title` key; `quickjs-runner.ts` 845–848 installs `ctx.title` only when the host built the seam ("hook bodies; the action face does not"). The heading tells a reader that `ctx.title()` exists in action bodies, where it is `undefined`. It descends from part 2's carried `adr_note_addendum` ("In a hook or action body, ctx.title() …"), which record 6249342777 ③.7 passed unremarked; items 5–8 themselves say "the hook fires on" and "a `runAs: 'user'` hook". This is the one statement the addendum makes that is not true of `main`, and it is a declared-not-delivered statement of exactly the kind this card closed. Fix: the heading reads "Hook bodies (`packages/runtime/src/sandbox/body-runner.ts`, the hook face)". Two words; it needs a new head.

11. Provenance sentence "It states what those two changes put on `main`" — a nit, not a behavioural claim: item 9's three refusals predate both PRs (`INVALID_SORT` from #7095, the virtual-search refusal from #6674); #24274 pinned the engine sort refusal and wrote the describe strings. "states what is on `main` after them" would be exact. Not blocking; take it in the same re-push if one happens.

### ② Semver level

Docs-only: one file under `docs/adr/`, no package, no `.changeset`. `skip-changeset` is the right label (AGENTS.md: the label is for a diff that publishes nothing from any released package), and `Check Changeset` concluded success. The PR body's `Clause-②: no (an ADR note records what shipped; …)` reads as declared, value `no`, no arm, through `readClause2Line` (`clause2-line.mjs` 418: `matchValueToken` takes `no`; `readArmToken` 280 sees a parenthetical whose first word `an` is neither an arm nor an arm-family word, so `arm: null` and not malformed). RIGHT: nothing widens and nothing narrows. The tier is `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` by the rules face — `docs/adr/**` is a Tier H register row (`check-governed-merges.mjs` 1177) — so this record is owed, and the landing is a governed approver's word plus the owning seat.

### ③ Boundary flags

The dev's report is 6249874213; the dispatch is 6249693922; the claim is 6249662765.

1. Open question 1 ("shown on every surface": name the two verified surfaces; A shipped). ANSWERED: A is right, and the closing bullet does it — but the heading in ①.10 undoes the restraint on the other side by naming a surface (action bodies) that has no accessor. The fix in ①.10 restores it.

2. Open question 2 (also qualify D1's "real STORED"; A shipped). ANSWERED: A is right. D1's quoted sentence says a formula title is a "real STORED field" and item 9 says a formula is stored nowhere; both are now on the page, and the addendum says which is true while editing neither. It is a qualification of a descriptive word, not a reversal of D1's decision, so PD #13 asks for no superseding ADR and no status-line edit.

3. Open question 3 (leave out the save door's 422 and the optional-read split; A shipped). ANSWERED: A is acceptable. Both omitted facts are true at this head (the lint runs in the metadata save door, measured 422 `INVALID_METADATA` in report 6247217617; `formulaHopScope`'s `empty` branch and the repair-first fault at `engine.ts` 2744–2750), and leaving them out makes nothing false.

4. Deviations (five). All process, accepted: the recreated worktree and its removal; the PR bodies of #24274 / #24307 not read in full (this record likewise verified in code, not in those bodies); the model-free attribution trailer; no PR-activity subscription.

5. `out_of_scope_findings` (other title consumers — `searchAll` hit titles in metadata-protocol, plugin-approvals `recordTitleOf` over `ctx.previous` — not verified for a title over lookups). ACCEPTED as noted, not escalated: no defect is asserted, and the addendum's last bullet disclaims those consumers. It stays on the seat's list for the next engine or approvals touch; nothing is owed on this PR.

6. **The red check-run** `Part-of PR must not also close its card` (`partof-closing-keyword-guard.yml` → `scripts/check-partof-closing-keyword.mjs` → H7). Cause, read from the body and the predicate: `partOfRe()` (`check-half-states.mjs` 2426) is case-insensitive, so the Summary's "Part 3, the last part of #24197" is read as a `Part of #24197` declaration, while the body's first line `Fixes #24197` — which dispatch 6249693922 asked for, this being the last part — is a closing keyword on the same number. Remedy: a body edit by the seat (the dev's rule 3 hands body edits to the seat), rewording the Summary so the two words "part of" do not precede `#24197` — for example "Part 3, the last of the three parts of card #24197" — keeping `Fixes #24197`; the workflow subscribes `edited`, so the check re-fires on the edit with no push. The verdict below does not rest on this red; it must be green before the approval request either way.

7. Carried from the earlier records, checked here: 6247399985 ③.4 (`user` and `tree` are references) is in item 1; ③.8b (FLS on the carrying FK column) is item 4; 6249342777 ③.7's three additions (the channel's identity, the channel that cannot read, FLS on the title field) are items 5, 6 and 7. All carried, all true.

8. Reviewer's own notes, none blocking: (a) item 2's "the reason does not say which of the two held" holds for the response (`null` in every case) and for the not-found / RLS-hidden pair (`unresolved`); a hop read that throws — an object-level `PERMISSION_DENIED` from the related object's middleware included — reports a third sentence, "that read failed", to the log (`formulaHopRefusal` `unreadable`), so an operator reading logs can tell a thrown read from a not-found; the reader cannot. (b) Items 5 and 6 say `null`; the host seam answers `undefined` and the VM wire converts (`quickjs-runner.ts` 903) — right for bodies, which is what the items address. (c) The record's Scope includes `script-runner.ts`, `stored-metadata-reader-seam.ts`, `hook-wrappers.ts` and `field-masker.ts` beyond the PR body's table, because items 4–6 lean on them.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-24197-adr-0079-note`
Reviewed-by: `session_01JtSQQ3EWsbNPzyYMug1tXy`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

One WRONG statement (①.10): the heading "Hook and action bodies" places `ctx.title()` in action bodies, which have no such accessor at this head. Items 1–9 are each RIGHT, the fence holds, the ruling is quoted verbatim, no unlanded behaviour is described, and #24284 / #24316 are neither named nor described — so the fix is the two-word heading change (and, optionally, the ①.11 provenance word), then a fresh record on the new head. Separately, the PR body needs the ③.6 rewording before the approval request.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `73fd87521c8e5898b93c08aab6ab71deb28fc3d0`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0079-record-display-name.md + packages/runtime/src/sandbox/body-runner.ts, packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts, packages/objectql/src/engine.ts, packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts, packages/objectql/src/record-title.ts, packages/objectql/src/hook-run-as.ts, packages/objectql/src/hook-wrappers.ts, packages/spec/src/data/field-value.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/data/search-fields.ts, packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts, packages/formula/src/validate.ts, packages/formula/src/relationship-traversal.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/field-masker.ts, packages/runtime/src/sandbox/script-runner.ts, packages/runtime/src/stored-metadata-reader-seam.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts, docs/adr/0048-cross-package-metadata-collision.md, scripts/check-partof-closing-keyword.mjs, scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs, scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs, scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs, .github/workflows/pr-automation.yml

Delta review on top of record 6250184223 (head `da22e1db2a`, FAIL on ①.10 alone, ①.11 a non-blocking nit). Inputs: that record in full; card #24197 (the body with its `Ruled:` line and all 21 comments — the claims, dispatches, the four `os-dev-report` comments and the rework report 6250259693 read as claims, the ACCEPTs, the two landing comments, the seat's rework comment 6250198140); PR #24323 (body, the one-file list, zero review comments, one issue comment — the prior record); the interdiff `git diff da22e1db2a 6d6ecfe5a5 -- docs/adr/0079-record-display-name.md`; the merge commit `73fd87521c` (parents `6d6ecfe5a5` and `1ef0ee89d4`, the merge base); the net diff `1ef0ee89d4..73fd87521c`; the head's check-runs. Blob ids of every Scope file were compared across `da22e1db2a`, `73fd87521c` and `origin/main` `ec749fbb44`. Nothing was built, run or re-run; the dev's gate claims were not reproduced.

What the delta is: one file, two hunks, three lines (`--numstat 3 3`). Lines 345–346, the provenance sentence, now read "It states what is on `main` after those two changes and decides nothing more"; line 376, the group heading over items 5–8, now reads "**Hook bodies** (`packages/runtime/src/sandbox/body-runner.ts`, the hook face):". No other line of the file moved between `da22e1db2a` and `6d6ecfe5a5`. The merge commit changes nothing in the file (`git diff 6d6ecfe5a5 73fd87521c -- docs/adr/0079-record-display-name.md` is empty); it brought four paths (`.changeset/24287-hono-stream-string-verbatim.md`, two hono adapter files, one http-conformance test), none a file the addendum rests on, and all 21 cited files carry the same blob at `da22e1db2a` and at `73fd87521c`. The net diff against the merge base is still `docs/adr/0079-record-display-name.md` +77/−0 in the same two hunks (the `- **Addenda**:` pointer line in the header block; the appended section at 342–414). `main`'s copy of the file is 337 lines, unchanged since the merge base; the head's is 414.

Check-runs on `73fd87521c`, read at 2026-10-18T13:21Z: 39, all completed, 31 success, 8 skipped, **0 failure**. The five queue contexts: `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core` (and its six shards) and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` success; `Build Core` skipped by path, as on the prior head. **`Part-of PR must not also close its card` is now success** (13:04:34Z) — ③.2. `Check Changeset` is `skipped` on this head, by design — ②. The other skips are the path and opt-in lanes the prior record listed.

### ① Derived judgments

10. The group heading over items 5–8 — **now RIGHT.** It names hook bodies and the hook face, which is where `ctx.title()` exists and the only place it does, read in the code at this head (`body-runner.ts` blob `6b7ebfb70c`, `quickjs-runner.ts` blob `ce00ed6dac`, both identical to `main`): `buildTitleSurface` is called once, at `body-runner.ts` 371, inside the hook's `boundBodyHandler` with `{ kind: 'hook', name: hook.name }`; the hook context object carries `title` (1175) under the comment at 1171–1174, "Hook face only. The action face has its own record shape … deliberately not taken here — the ruling names hook bodies"; `buildActionSandboxContext` (1197–1247) assembles `input`, `previous`, `user`, `session`, `object`, `recordId`, `record`, `recordLoadDenied`, `api`, `log`, `crypto` and no `title`; `quickjs-runner.ts` 845–848 says "Installed only when the host built the seam (hook bodies; the action face does not)" and 876 installs the VM function only when `typeof ctx.title === 'function'`. Items 5–8 (378–392) say nothing about action bodies: the only case-insensitive occurrence of "action" in the whole addendum is "transaction's connection" at 382, and each item names its surface as a hook ("the hook fires on", "a `runAs: 'user'` hook"). The heading now states exactly the surface the closing bullet (412–414) claims was verified.

11. The provenance sentence — **now exact.** "It states what is on `main` after those two changes" no longer attributes item 9's pre-existing refusals (`INVALID_SORT`, the virtual-search `INVALID_FIELD`) to #24274 / #24307; it dates the statements without crediting them. "decides nothing more; no section above is edited" is unchanged and still true (+77/−0 in the two hunks).

1–9. **Each RIGHT, carried from record 6250184223 by interdiff, not re-derived.** The lines carrying items 1–4 (357–374), 5–8 (378–392), 9 (396–402) and the three qualification bullets (406–414) are byte-identical to `da22e1db2a`, and every file the prior readings cite has the same blob id at `da22e1db2a` and at this head, so the prior record's readings (symbols and line numbers included) are readings of this head. Two of those files have since moved on `origin/main` (`ec749fbb44`, two commits past the merge base: #24317 and #24320): `engine.ts` +52/−1 and `protocol.ts` +14/−1, both from #24320. Read against those hunks, since the addendum claims to state `main`: `engine.ts` adds `emptySearchSetError` (2033 on `main`) and one `throw` of it in the search expansion (13768–13781) when a non-blank `search` resolves to an empty field set; `protocol.ts` excludes `internal: true` columns from `searchAll`'s per-object skip set (15862). Neither touches `planFormulaProjection`, `resolveFormulaRelated`, `resolveOneHopRelated`, `formulaHopScope`, `applyFormulaPlan`, `formulaHopRefusal`, `formulaHopReads`, `hydrateWriteFormulas`, `assertOrderByIsMaterializable`, `serveFormulaField`, `withRunAs` or `assertSearchFieldsAreSearchable`. Item 9 in particular stays RIGHT on current `main`: "a `searchableFields` entry naming it is dropped" is still `resolveSearchFieldResolution` over `isVirtualSearchField` (`search-fields.ts`, unchanged); what #24320 adds is a refusal AFTER the drop, when nothing searchable remains, which item 9 neither states nor contradicts. Omitting it makes nothing false — ③.6.

Fence, quotation, exclusion. The fence holds: the diff adds and deletes nothing outside the two hunks; Provenance, Context, D1–D10, the status table, the open questions and the alternatives are untouched; the two qualifications (the Alternatives bullet's "*can* return and query"; D1's "real STORED") are still made in the addendum's own text. The ruling is quoted verbatim: lines 349–352, unwrapped, equal the card's `Ruled:` sentence byte for byte (compared programmatically against the card body's second line; the trailing board-state words "p1 `target:v18` stands …" are rightly left out), and the interdiff did not touch the blockquote. Neither `24284` nor `24316` appears anywhere in the file at this head, and neither path is described: item 9 does not describe the empty-set answer (#24284, now #24320 on `main`), item 4 says nothing about stored-metadata family tables (#24316). The pointer line (9) and the heading (342) are unchanged from the prior head, so the slug equality carries; `Check Documentation Links` is green on this head.

### ② Semver level

Docs-only: one file under `docs/adr/`, no package, no `.changeset`. `skip-changeset` is the right label (AGENTS.md: the label is for a diff that publishes nothing from any released package). `Check Changeset` is `skipped` on this head because the job-level `if:` (`pr-automation.yml` 289–290, `!contains(labels, 'skip-changeset')`) saw the label on the `synchronize` event's payload — the exemption firing whole, not a gate left unmeasured; the prior head's green run was the `labeled` event's re-run after a first `skipped`. The PR body's `Clause-②: no (an ADR note records what shipped; …)` is byte-identical to the prior head's and sits at the start of body line 3; through `readClause2Line` (`clause2-line.mjs` 418, blob unchanged): `matchValueToken` takes `no`; `readArmToken` (280) sees a parenthetical whose first word `an` is neither an arm nor an arm-family word, so `arm: null` and not malformed; no `no (widening)` contradiction. RIGHT: nothing widens and nothing narrows.
